evidence.detail: StructuredOutputSpec.from_dataclass(AuthorityResolution) yields status/basis_evidence_ref_ids/required_evidence/independent_resolution all as {}; sibling string fields remain constrained. AuthorityResolution is a runtime object, so no live LLM contract is currently affected.
try get_type_hints / except fallback to raw __annotations__; then _type_to_schema receives 'AuthorityResolution | None' as a plain string and returns {} silently.

findings.impact: Any future LLM output dataclass that mixes 'X | None' loses its entire output contract without an error, silently breaking the 'one output truth source' invariant. Same defect class as the tuple bug closed in CG-AUTH-003, but for PEP 604 unions.
findings.problem: The Structured Output schema renderer silently collapses an entire dataclass schema to unconstrained {} when get_type_hints fails. On the project runtime (Python 3.9), any dataclass with a PEP 604 'X | None' annotation under 'from __future__ import annotations' triggers the failure; the renderer falls back to raw string annotations and every field becomes {}.
findings.remediation: Fail loudly when get_type_hints fails (or normalize PEP 604 unions before render); add a governance scanner check that flags LLM output specs whose properties are empty/{}.
verification_evidence: impl/core/structured_output.py: _dataclass_to_schema now resolves annotations per-field when get_type_hints fails; _resolve_annotation handles PEP 604 'X | None' (simple names, generics like List[str]/tuple[str, ...], and quoted forward refs) and raises ValueError instead of silently degrading to unconstrained {}.

evidence.detail: agno/models/base.py: run_function_call sets function_call_output = str(function_call.result); create_function_call_result uses content=output.

findings.impact: The model must parse non-JSON repr (single quotes, True/False/None) for a task that demands verbatim copying of unit_ids; and the governance audit tool_call_log (JSON) is not byte-faithful to the actual model context (repr), weakening snapshot-to-context fidelity.
findings.problem: Tool results enter the model context as Python repr, not JSON. Agno's create_function_call_result sets content=str(function_call.result), so list/dict tool returns (Search/Load candidates, navigation results) appear as single-quoted Python repr with True/False/None tokens.
findings.remediation: Serialize tool return values to JSON before they enter agno messages (wrap GuardedContextTools results), and keep the audit log byte-identical to the model view.
verification_evidence: impl/tools/protocol.py: json_tool/_serialize_tool_result serialize ToolResult/dict/list returns to JSON text at the LLM boundary; functools.wraps preserves the original signature so agno from_callable keeps the parameter schema.

gate.reason: No blocking context-engineering defect found in the Authority path itself; CG-ENG-001/002/004/005/006/007/008 closed with regression + real-run verification, CG-ENG-003 remains open (informational: no real governed Authority record exists yet in production data). CG-ENG-006 also lands P4: enhanced-rules and sibling field-level slice assets are declared for value-level key-index with a manifest validation gate.

objective: Review the Authority context engineering itself (independent of upstream business-source drift): output contract rendering, tool-result serialization into the model context, information isolation between Authority phases, governance snapshot fidelity, and Judge-to-Authority consumption.
positive_controls: Phase-1 Authority user payload contains only decision_question + environment_snapshot_sha256; claim is excluded (info isolation).
Phase-2 claim comparison runs on a tool-less client and the system prompt forbids searching/loading/rewriting the independent conclusion; status compatibility is runtime-enforced.
AuthorityIndependentResolution and _AuthorityClaimComparison LLM output contracts render correctly (Literal enums, tuple->array).
Authority Load exposes materialized unit_id while Search returns only selection_refs; candidate width and load width are runtime-owned caps.
Search->Load ordering and tool-call budget are validated deterministically after each run.
Judge exposes authority.resolve only when deterministic candidate signals exist; the prompt forbids fabricating authority_tool_call_ids otherwise.
Judge pre-obligations inject only decision refs (governs_summary truncated), not the full 19KB authority report.
Material decisions are handled as proof-scope contracts, not facts; M1 trust-model limitations are explicit in the Authority system prompt.
Claim 比对载荷携带 context_coverage 结构化 trace 信号，ungoverned/gap_only 分类可审计，不依赖模型自述。
Claim 比对阶段在模型边界强制 tools_override=[]，注入同一 client 时工具 schema 不再暴露。
字段级切片（field / yaml_mapping_field）的值级召回由声明驱动的 authority.evidence.<ref_id> 索引承担，description 只保留摘要；索引不是证据，load_entry 后必须再 Context Load。
大切片资料（field / yaml_mapping_field / yaml_list_chunk）有调查产物门禁：无 manifest 显式索引或 metadata.key_index 声明的切片资料校验拒绝。
Search 无候选/无决定性候选时允许用内部对象索引做值级/字段级检索；命中 load_targets 必须立即 Load；治理边界（禁止并行导航/扩搜）保留。
